open_points.subject: sandbox resource-limit enforcement
open_points.text: State 3 assigns `sandbox` “limits enforced from outside”, while changed A03 rule 5 requires “the process count by the runner inside the environment's user namespace before the code loads”.
open_points.question: Does `sandbox` own a split mechanism—address-space enforcement in the parent and process-count enforcement in its in-sandbox runner—or must all resource limits be enforced outside the environment?
options: Update State 3 to assign the parent-side address-space limit and runner-side process-count limit explicitly to `sandbox`.
Change A03 so the process-count limit is also enforced outside the environment.
open_points.default_guess: Treat changed A03 as authoritative and update `sandbox` to own both sides of the split enforcement mechanism.
